# Lamp maintenance

## Lens care

The lens is polished with chamois and rouge every ninth day. The keeper wears
cotton gloves, because skin oil leaves a film that shows up as a smear on the
beam.

## Mantles and wicks

Spare mantles are kept in locker four of the lamp room. The wick is trimmed at
dusk, before the lamp is lit, and the trimmings go into the tin pail and never
onto the floor.

## When the lamp fails

If the lamp fails, the keeper sounds the fog horn in the long pattern and
telephones the harbour office. The lamp is not relit until the cause is
written in the log.
